synopsis: Guided by his best friend Aradhana, Aksara practices confessing his feelings to the girl of his dreams. However, an unexpected kiss mid-rehearsal changes everything and sparks feelings he never knew existed. Even after winning his crush's heart, the success feels strange and empty. Trapped between a smile and unspoken regret, Aksara is left haunted by what could have been with Aradhana.
